email.subject: Thanks for the help with my headphones
email.body:
Hi there,

I just wanted to write in about the service I got at your West Lake store last weekend. I'd been having trouble with a pair of wireless headphones I bought a few months back — they kept cutting out on one side — and honestly I went in expecting a hassle.

The person who helped me (I'm sorry, I didn't catch his name, but he was working the electronics counter on Saturday afternoon) took the time to actually listen to what was going wrong. He tried them himself, asked a couple of questions about when it happened, and then walked me through what my options were without any pressure. He even showed me how to reset them properly, which I hadn't known about.

It's a small thing, but it made a difference to me. I've been back to using them all week and so far so good. Please pass along my thanks if you can.

Best,
Daniel

email.subject: Order arrived damaged - tea gift box
email.body: Hi, I ordered a tea gift box from your Beijing Chaoyang store last week and it arrived today. The outer box was fine but when I opened it, the gift box inside was crushed on one corner and a couple of the tea tins were dented. This was supposed to be a gift for a friend's birthday this weekend, so I'm pretty disappointed. I already called the store earlier and the person I spoke to said to email with photos, so I've attached a few. I'd really like to get this sorted before Saturday if possible. Thanks.

email.subject: 咖啡机送到时外箱破损，机器也有磕碰
email.body:
你好，

我上周在宁波天一店订了一台咖啡机，今天上午收到的。快递员送来的时候外箱侧面有一道挺长的裂口，当时我急着出门就签收了，没让他等。

下午拆开看，机器右下角有一块明显的磕痕，漆面掉了一点。我拍了照片，需要的话可以发给你们。

这台是打算放家里用的，现在这样我不太放心直接通电试。想问问这种情况一般怎么处理，是换一台还是怎么弄？麻烦回复一下，谢谢。

另外提一句，外箱裂口的位置正好在机器那一侧，感觉运输途中可能被压过。

email.subject: 咖啡机使用感受及一点疑问
email.body:
您好，

上个月在宁波天一店买了一台咖啡机，整体用下来挺满意的，出咖啡的速度和口感都不错，家里人都觉得买得值。店员当时介绍得也很耐心，这点想特别说声谢谢。

不过有个小问题一直没解决：机器用了一段时间后，水箱那里偶尔会渗一点水出来，量不大，但每次都要擦一下。我按照说明书重新装过水箱，也清洗过密封的位置，情况好了一些，但还是偶尔会出现。

想问问这种情况一般是什么原因，需不需要拿过去看一下？不着急，方便的时候回复我就行。

谢谢！

email.subject: Question about my receipt from the Nanshan store
email.body:
Hi there,

I stopped by the Shenzhen Nanshan store last weekend and picked up a jar of face cream. The staff member who helped me was genuinely lovely — she took the time to walk me through the different options and didn't rush me at all, which I appreciated.

When I looked at my receipt afterwards, though, I noticed a line for a service charge that I hadn't expected. It's not a huge amount, but I honestly don't remember anyone mentioning it at the counter, so I wanted to ask what it's for. Was it something I agreed to without realizing?

I'm not trying to make a fuss — the cream itself has been great so far — I'd just like to understand the charge before I come back.

Thanks,
Jamie
